idea-plugin.description:
Names every line in the file you have open that starts a recurring cloud charge, with the published us-east-1 price and the date it changes by itself.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Cloud Cost Landmine Lint for Terraform, CloudFormation and: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 27 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cloud-cost-landmine-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cloud-cost-landmine-lint
